commands.name: auto-switch-input
commands.title: Enforce Input Device
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Keeps your default input device and pinned volumes in place. Runs silently in the background every minute. If you disable this, your default device and pinned volumes will stop being enforced — macOS may switch devices or reset volumes after sleep, Bluetooth reconnects, etc.

commands.name: auto-switch-output
commands.title: Enforce Output Device
commands.subtitle: Audio Device
commands.description: Keeps your default output device and pinned volumes in place. Runs silently in the background every minute. If you disable this, your default device and pinned volumes will stop being enforced — macOS may switch devices or reset volumes after sleep, Bluetooth reconnects, etc.

tools.name: list-audio-devices
tools.title: List Audio Devices
tools.description: List available input or output devices, their IDs, and which one is currently active. Use before switching to a named device.
tools.instructions: List audio devices and identify the currently active device.

type.description: Whether to list microphones (input) or speakers and headphones (output).

tools.name: set-audio-device
tools.title: Set Audio Device
tools.description: Switch the active input or output device using an ID from List Audio Devices.

type.description: Whether to switch the microphone (input) or speakers/headphones (output).

deviceId.description: Exact device ID returned by list-audio-devices. Do not use a device name.

tools.name: get-audio-volume
tools.title: Get Audio Volume
tools.description: Get the current input or output device volume as a percentage from 0 to 100.
tools.instructions: Get the volume of the currently active input or output device.

type.description: Whether to read microphone (input) or speaker/headphone (output) volume.

tools.name: set-audio-volume
tools.title: Set Audio Volume
tools.description: Set the current input or output device volume to a percentage from 0 to 100.
tools.instructions: Set the volume of the currently active input or output device.

type.description: Whether to change microphone (input) or speaker/headphone (output) volume.

preferences.title: Play sound effects through current output
preferences.description: Play system sounds through current output.
preferences.label: Update system sounds output

preferences.title: Favourite Output Device
preferences.description: The name, as found in the output device list, of the output device to use as the first favourite

scripts.build: npm run copy-binary && ray build -e dist

ai.instructions:
Use list-audio-devices before switching to a named device. Pass its exact ID to set-audio-device.
Input devices are microphones. Output devices are speakers and headphones.
Use get-audio-volume to read the current input or output volume.
